# IWETH
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/misc/IWETH.sol)

**Title:**
IWETH

Minimal interface for Wrapped Ether (WETH)


## Functions
### deposit

Wraps the sent ETH into WETH, crediting the caller


```solidity
function deposit() external payable;
```

### transfer

Transfers WETH to a recipient


```solidity
function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`to`|`address`|The recipient|
|`value`|`uint256`|The amount to transfer|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if the transfer succeeded|


### withdraw

Unwraps WETH back into ETH, sending it to the caller


```solidity
function withdraw(uint256) external;
```

### balanceOf

Returns the WETH balance of an account


```solidity
function balanceOf(address) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The WETH balance|
